info.title: SOYL Academy Learning Platform API
info.description: Called by the web tier through the same-origin proxy at /api/platform (ADR-005). Errors are RFC 7807 problem+json. Auth is a session cookie (__Host-soyl_session). State-changing requests need an allow-listed Origin and Content-Type: application/json.

methods.description: Enabled sign-in methods, in display order

PatchMeInput.description: API-8: only these fields; role, status, xp etc. are rejected (400).

ReviewStatusInput.description: beta = published after automated checks; reviewed = human-reviewed (CONTEXT §4).

StudentQuestionInput.description: A question without its answer, solution or marking scheme (DB-6). Check answers with POST /v1/practice/answers.

ChapterHubInput.description: Public and cacheable; your own progress is GET /v1/me/progress/chapters/{id}.

StreakInput.description: IST calendar days; one missed day per week is covered automatically.

PracticePartResponseInput.description: mcq/assertion-reason/true-false/multi-select → option_ids; numerical → value; fill-blank → blanks (in stem order); match → pairs; ordering → order (all ids); code-output → output; short/long/writing/map → text.

PracticeResponseInput.description: case-based/source-based → parts (one per child; `alternative` picks an internal-choice alternative).

AnswerKeyInput.description: Revealed only after answering (F-006). `answer` has the content contract Answer shape.

MfaEnrollmentInput.description: Show the URI as a QR code (and the secret for manual entry). Nothing here is stored in the browser.

MfaRecoveryCodesInput.description: Shown once. Each code works once.

get.summary: Liveness
Readiness: database and key-value store
Enabled sign-in methods (the login sheet hides the others)

post.summary: Send a sign-in code by SMS (+91 mobiles only)
Verify an SMS code and sign in (creates the account on first use)
Send a sign-in code by email
Verify an email code and sign in (creates the account on first use)

get.summary: Start Google sign-in (302 to Google). intent=link adds Google to the signed-in account (fresh session).

302.description: Redirect to the Google authorization endpoint

get.summary: Google redirect target. Signs in (or links) and 302s to the validated returnTo; failures add ?authError=<reason>.

302.description: Redirect back to the web app

post.summary: Sign out: deletes the session and sends Clear-Site-Data: "cookies"
Send a code to a phone number to add it to your account
Verify the code and add the phone number to your account
Send a code to an email address to add it to your account
Verify the code and add the email address to your account
Remove a sign-in method (never the last one)

get.summary: Current session (guest when not signed in)
Your profile, consent state and sign-in methods

delete.summary: Delete your account: personal data is removed now, the rest is purged within 30 days. Needs a fresh sign-in.

post.summary: Merge guest progress (localStorage soyl_guest_v1) into the account. Once per account; replays return alreadyMerged.

get.summary: Your active sessions
Boards and their classes
Subjects for a board and class
Chapters (with topics) of a subject, in board order
Chapter hub: chapter, subject and the published lesson, notes, flashcards, practice and tests with counts
Lesson slides for one deck part (default: the first). Check-slide questions come without answers.
Chapter notes
Chapter flashcards
Practice questions of a chapter (stems and options only), paged. Signed in: questions you have not answered come first.

post.summary: Check a practice answer on the server. Returns correctness, the answer, solution and marking scheme. Guests are checked but not stored.

patch.summary: Self-assess the written parts of one of your practice answers against the marking scheme

get.summary: Your XP, level, streak and per-chapter lesson and practice progress
Your progress in one chapter (the private half of the chapter hub)

put.summary: Save your lesson position or completion (idempotent)

get.summary: Badges you can earn and the ones you have

post.summary: Report a mistake in a lesson, notes, flashcard or question

get.summary: Your two-step verification status (staff)

post.summary: Start setting up an authenticator app (staff; fresh sign-in)
Confirm the authenticator with a first code; returns one-time recovery codes
Verify this session with an authenticator code or a recovery code
Turn off the authenticator (fresh, verified session and a current code)

get.summary: Content reports queue (staff, two-step verified session)
